n: Wikipedia says that in 306 Sima Teng led over 10,000 Bingzhou followers to Ye to seek grain, not 20,000+ households.
n_zh: 维基称光熙元年（306年）并州饥荒，司马腾率并州部众一万多人赴邺求粮，并非二万余户。

n: Wikipedia traditionally dates the Gun-Yu flood to about 2300-2200 BCE, earlier than the claimed 2100-2000 BCE, and gives no 1920 BCE geological link.
n_zh: 维基百科称鲧禹治水传统上约在公元前2300-2200年，早于所给的公元前2100-2000年，也未提及约前1920年的地质关联。

n: Wikipedia gives 1,328 deaths for the Haicheng quake (plus fire and cold deaths afterwards), not a clear ~2,000.
n_zh: 维基百科称海城地震死亡1328人（另有震后火灾、冻死者），与约二千人的说法不尽一致。

n: Wikipedia places the Henan drought and locust plague in 1942-43, not 1943-44, and names no 1944 plague.
n_zh: 维基百科称河南旱灾与蝗灾发生于1942—1943年，未提及1944年蝗灾。

n: The Chinese article places Tang's seven-year drought in Tang's 18th-24th years, 1766-1760 BC, while the claim says 1600-1594 BC; Tang's dates are themselves uncertain.
n_zh: 中文条目称成汤十八年至二十四年（前1766-1760年）连续七年大旱，与所给的前1600-1594年不符，且汤的年代本身不确定。

n: Checked against the 1393 provincial figures quoted on Wikipedia (Zhejiang about 16%, Huguang 7%, Sichuan 2%, the five northern provinces 29%, the five southern 16%); Jiangxi here is a little high (Wikipedia about 12%).
n_zh: 已与维基百科所引洪武二十六年分省人口对照（浙江约16%、湖广7%、四川2%、北五省29%、南五省16%）；此处江西略高（维基约12%）。

n: Checked against Wikipedia for 1820 (south 71.4%, north 28.6%; the provinces above 20 million); Zhili here is a little high (Wikipedia: under 20 million).
n_zh: 已与维基百科嘉庆二十五年数据对照（南方71.4%、北方28.6%，人口逾两千万的各省）；此处直隶略高（维基：不足两千万）。

n: The English article says he was born in Taiyuan, Shanxi, while the Chinese article says Xinzheng, Henan.
n_zh: 英文条目称生于山西太原，中文条目称生于河南新郑，两者不一致。

n: Sources differ: Chinese Wikipedia has Bai Qi attacking Handan in 259 BC, while English Wikipedia dates the Handan siege he declined to 257 BC.
n_zh: 来源不一：中文维基称前259年白起攻邯郸，英文维基称其称病不出的邯郸之围在前257年。

n: The source says he left the Liang court in 527 before the nine years at Mount Song, not c. 521.
n_zh: 文献称其527年离梁入嵩山面壁九年，而非约521年。

n: Wikipedia notes most contemporary sources imply a birth in the late 1320s, and 1336 may have been a later construction.
n_zh: 维基百科指出同时代多数史料暗示他生于1320年代末，1336年之说存疑。

n: Wikipedia says Herat did not surrender and was razed and its citizens massacred; 1381 refers to Khwaja Mas'ud's (Sarbadar) surrender.
n_zh: 维基百科称赫拉特未投降而被夷平屠城；1381年投降的是萨尔巴达尔的马苏德。

n: Wikipedia says Isfahan surrendered at once in 1387 and was treated with relative mercy; no revolt or massacre is given in the passage.
n_zh: 维基百科称1387年伊斯法罕立即投降并受到相对宽大对待，所给段落未提起事和屠城。

n: The Chinese article places the family's Beijing house outside Chongwenmen at Ciqikou, not Caishikou, and gives no year.
n_zh: 中文条目称曹家在北京的住所为崇文门外磁器口，而非蒜市口，且未给出年份。

n: Wikipedia (zh) says he went to the capital and studied at the Imperial Academy in 682, failing the exam the next year.
n_zh: 中文维基称其开耀元年（682年）入京游太学，次年应试不第。

fix.text: 682: Leaves Sichuan for the capital and studies at the Imperial Academy; fails his first examinations.
fix.text_zh: 682年，出蜀入京，游太学，初试落第。

n: Wikipedia (zh) has him reach Chen in 492 BC and move on to Cai in 491 BC, not settle in Chen for about three years.
n_zh: 维基百科称孔子前492年到陈国，前491年即赴蔡国，并非在陈国居留约三年。

n: Wikipedia dates his arrival in Cao to 639 BC, not 637.
n_zh: 维基百科称重耳到曹国在前639年，而非前637年。

fix.text: 639 BC: Duke Gong of Cao spies on him bathing to see his fused ribs, an insult he later avenges.
fix.text_zh: 前639年，曹共公偷看其骈胁沐浴，此辱后来报复。

n: The Chinese article says Liu Xiu destroyed a Wang Mang army of 10,000 with 3,000 men; it does not give 420,000.
n_zh: 中文条目称刘秀率三千人击灭王莽军一万，未见四十二万之数。

n: Wikipedia says Columbus and his men remained stranded on Jamaica for six months after beaching in June 1503, not a year.
n_zh: 维基百科称1503年6月搁浅后，哥伦布一行在牙买加困守六个月，而非一年。

n: Wikipedia says he joined the Ragamuffin rebels in 1835 after arriving in Brazil; the 1836 Rio arrival is not given.
n_zh: 维基百科称他1835年抵达巴西后加入里奥格兰德起义者，未给出1836年抵达里约之说。

n: Wikipedia (zh) dates his appointment to Jingjiang prefecture to 1171, not 1173.
n_zh: 维基百科称其1171年（乾道七年）出知静江府，而非1173年。

fix.text: 1171: Governor of Guilin; his notes become the Guihai Yuheng Zhi on the south's landscapes and peoples.
fix.text_zh: 1171年，知静江府，后撰《桂海虞衡志》记岭南风物。

n: The Chinese article places Wuyang county in present-day Xiangyuan, Changzhi, not Linfen.
n_zh: 中文条目称武阳县在今山西长治市襄垣县，而非临汾一带。

fix.text: 337: Born in Pingyang commandery (Wuyang county, modern Xiangyuan, Changzhi, Shanxi); he is given to the monastery as a child.
fix.text_zh: 337年，生于平阳郡武阳（今山西长治市襄垣县），幼年即出家为沙弥。

n: Wikipedia (zh) says that from 744 he travelled with Li Bai and Du Fu around Shanfu (Shandong), not in the Liang-Song region.
n_zh: 中文维基称744年起他与李白、杜甫同游单父（今山东单县），而非梁宋。

n: Wikipedia says he was called to Nanjing to serve in the Ministry of War in early 1645, not 1644.
n_zh: 维基百科称他于1645年初才被召至南京任兵部之职，而非1644年。

n: Wikipedia says Kunshan fell after Gu had left for Nanjing, so 'joins the defence' is not supported.
n_zh: 维基百科称昆山陷落时顾炎武已前往南京，未提及他参加守城。

n: Wikipedia notes his death year is variously reported as 1314 or 1316.
n_zh: 维基百科称其卒年有1314年与1316年两说。

n: Wikipedia dates his appointment as Nanping instructor to 1553 (Jiajing 32), not 1554.
n_zh: 维基百科称海瑞于1553年（嘉靖三十二年）选授南平教谕，而非1554年。

fix.text: 1553: Becomes county instructor at Nanping and refuses to kneel to visiting censors.
fix.text_zh: 1553年，任福建南平县教谕，见上官不跪，人称“笔架博士”。

n: Wikipedia says he enlisted and stormed Yinzhou in 1105 at age seventeen.
n_zh: 维基百科称其1105年（崇宁四年）、十七岁投军并攻银州斩将。

fix.text: c. 1105: A seventeen-year-old recruit, he scales the walls of Yinzhou against the Xixia and kills its commander.
fix.text_zh: 约1105年，十七岁应募从军，攻西夏银州时率先登城斩将。

n: Sources differ: the Chinese article dates his post at Chuzhou to 1136, while the English article places it the year after 1134.
n_zh: 来源不一：中文条目称1136年（六年）置司楚州，英文条目则称1134年之后一年。

n: Wikipedia (zh) dates Prefect Wei Qu's invitation to preach at Dafan Temple to 677 (Yifeng 2), not c. 690.
n_zh: 中文维基记载韦璩请惠能于大梵寺说法在仪凤二年（677年），而非约690年。

fix.text: 677: Invited by Prefect Wei Qu to preach at Dafan Temple; the sermon becomes the core of the Platform Sutra.
fix.text_zh: 677年，应韶州刺史韦璩之请在大梵寺说法，记录成为《坛经》。

n: The source says he learned of his father's death around Damascus in 1348 and found his mother already dead only on reaching Tangier in 1349.
n_zh: 维基中文称他1348年经大马士革时得知父亲已死，母亲去世则是1349年回到丹吉尔后才发现。

n: zh article places the Lu Jianzeng affair in 1765, not 1769; exile year not given.
n_zh: 中文条目称卢见曾案发生于乾隆三十年（1765年），未给出发配的具体年份，与1769年不符。

n: Wikipedia says construction of Osaka Castle began in 1582, not 1583.
n_zh: 维基百科称大阪城于1582年开始兴建，而非1583年。

n: Wikipedia says that in 791 he went to Nara, the then capital, to enter the Daigakuryo, not Nagaoka-kyo.
n_zh: 维基百科称791年他前往当时的都城奈良入大学寮，而非长冈京。

n: Wikipedia says he finally met Huiguo and was initiated at Qinglong in 805, not 804.
n_zh: 维基百科称他于805年才见到惠果并在青龙寺受法。

n: Wikipedia gives 961 as the birth year but one passage says he was born in Daming prefecture while the lead says he was a native of Xiagui, Huazhou.
n_zh: 维基百科生年为961年，但生平一节称生于大名府，而首段称其为华州下邽人，说法不一。

n: Wikipedia (zh) says he was transferred to Yongxing in 1016 (九年二月) and moved to Xiangzhou in 1017.
n_zh: 维基百科称其于1016年（九年二月）徙判永兴军，1017年已改判襄州。

n: Wikipedia says Li Bai's birthplace is long debated between Mianyang, Sichuan and Suyab, so 'by most accounts' is not supported.
n_zh: 维基百科称李白出生地长期有争议（四川绵阳或碎叶），并无“多数记载”之说。

n: Wikipedia gives his birth as 466 or 472, not c. 470.
n_zh: 维基百科称其生于466年或472年，而非约470年。

n: Wikipedia says he was born at Xingyang (or Zhejiang by one account), and also that his father was magistrate of Huojia at the time.
n_zh: 维基称其生于荥阳（一说浙江），又称其出生时父亲任获嘉县令，出生地说法不一。

n: The Chinese article says the Prince of Chu summoned him at age 38 (about 1555), not 1551.
n_zh: 中文条目称楚王召他任奉祠正时他38岁（约1555年），与1551年不符。

n: Wikipedia (zh) gives his age at death as 46.
n_zh: 中文维基称其享年四十六岁。

fix.text_zh: 819年，卒于柳州，年四十六，世称“柳柳州”。

n: Wikipedia dates the fiefdom to 277 BC, when their father died, not 276 BC.
n_zh: 维基百科称信陵封邑在前277年（昭王去世时），而非前276年。

fix.text: 277 BC: His half-brother King Anxi enfeoffs him at Xinling.
fix.text_zh: 前277年，异母兄魏安釐王即位，封其于信陵，号信陵君。

n: Wikipedia gives his death as winter 803 to early 804 and says the place is disputed between Huzhou and Tianmen (Hubei).
n_zh: 维基百科称其卒于803年冬至804年初，且卒地有争议，一说湖州，一说湖北天门。

n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Mozi's death as 376 BC, not c. 391 BC, and the place is not stated.
n_zh: 中文维基给出墨子卒年为前376年，而非约前391年，且未说明卒地。

n: Sources disagree: English Wikipedia says 1536, Chinese says 1534-35.
n_zh: 来源不一：英文维基称1536年，中文维基称1534至1535年。

n: English Wikipedia says Phagpa was born in Ngari (West Tibet), while Chinese Wikipedia calls him a native of Sakya; year 1235 agrees.
n_zh: 英文维基称八思巴生于阿里（西藏西部），中文维基称其为萨迦人；1235年一致。

n: Wikipedia dates his secretary post for Sun Hui at Baoying to August 1671 (Kangxi 9), not 1670.
n_zh: 维基百科称他1671年八月在宝应为孙蕙做幕僚，而非1670年。

n: Wikipedia (en) says he was relieved of duty in early 1583, the Chinese article says dismissed in 1585; death on 17 Jan 1588 at home in Dengzhou is confirmed.
n_zh: 英文条目称他1583年初被免职，中文条目称1585年被免；1588年卒于登州家中则一致。

n: Wikipedia says she was born in Fuzhou (Fujian), while another passage places her birth at Yunxiao in 1879; Xiamen is not given as the birthplace.
n_zh: 维基百科称她生于福州，另一段落称生于云霄；均未说生于厦门。

n: The zh article places the second exile (south of the Yangtze) after 293 BC (King Qingxiang's 6th year), not c. 296 BC; 296 BC is when King Huai died.
n_zh: 维基百科将第二次流放（江南）置于前293年（顷襄王六年）之后，而前296年是怀王去世之年。

n: Wikipedia says the Rummindei inscription records the Lumbini visit in his 21st regnal year, not the 20th.
n_zh: 维基百科称鲁明迪石柱铭文记载他在即位第21年（而非第20年）到访蓝毗尼。

n: Wikipedia says that in 1088 he was only allowed to move within Xiuzhou and could live elsewhere from the next year, so settling at Dream Brook in 1088 is not supported.
n_zh: 维基百科称元祐三年（1088年）沈括仅获准在秀州境内活动，次年才允许到外州居住，故1088年定居梦溪园缺乏依据。

n: English Wikipedia gives his birth as 4 February 1601, Chinese Wikipedia as 16 December 1602.
n_zh: 英文维基记其生于1601年2月4日，中文维基记为1602年12月16日，两者不一致。

n: en says born in Quanzhou County, Guangxi, while zh says Guilin; sources disagree on birthplace.
n_zh: 英文条目称生于广西全州县，中文条目称桂林府人，来源对出生地说法不一。

n: zh says he lived around Xuancheng and Mount Huang about ten years, not fifteen; no 1666 date.
n_zh: 中文条目称在宣城敬亭山及黄山住了十年左右，而非十五年，且无1666年的记载。

n: en says he converted to Daoism in 1693 and returned to Yangzhou, not 1697; Dadi Hall not mentioned.
n_zh: 英文条目称1693年改信道教并返回扬州，而非1697年，亦未提及大涤草堂。

n: Sources give his birth as 382 BC (zh) or unknown (en), not c. 360.
n_zh: 中文条目作前382年生，英文条目生年未知，均与约前360年不合。

n: One passage says King Wei of Chu refused to join the alliance; another says all six states were persuaded.
n_zh: 英文条目一处称楚威王拒绝加入，另一处称六国皆被说服，说法不一。

n: Year and place are confirmed, but the Chinese article says gallbladder cancer, not liver cancer.
n_zh: 年份与地点得到印证，但中文条目称死因为胆囊癌，而非肝癌。

n: The Chinese article says that in 512 BC Wu eliminated the Chu dependencies Zhongwu and Xu, not Shu.
n_zh: 中文维基称前512年吴灭的是钟吾与徐两个楚国附庸，未提拔舒。

n: The Chinese article places his Zhenjun adjutant post at Jingkou under Liu Laozhi in 399; in 404 he served Liu Jingxuan at Jiangzhou.
n_zh: 中文条目称其任镇军参军于京口在399年，主官为刘牢之；404年则任刘敬宣参军于江州。

n: The Chinese article says his house burned down in 408 and he then moved to Nancun, without a later date such as 410.
n_zh: 中文条目称408年家中失火后随即移居南村，未给出410年。

n: Wikipedia gives his death as 676 (or 677) and says he drowned either on the way south to join his father or on the way back, aged 26 or 28, so the details are disputed.
n_zh: 维基百科称其卒于676年（一作677年），溺死于南下会父或返程途中，享年26或28岁，说法不一。

n: The Chinese article says he passed the jinshi in 727 but was only made collator in the Palace Library in 731 after the broad-learning examination.
n_zh: 中文维基称其727年进士及第，731年中博学宏词后才授秘书省校书郎。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says scholars disagree on his birth year (1308 to 1311) and there is no consensus; 1311 is only one view.
n_zh: 中文维基称学界对汪大渊生年说法不一（1308至1311年），无定论，1311年仅为一说。

n: Wikipedia dates his flight and life disguised as a Yao man in the Lingling-Chenzhou area to 1654, and does not give 1653.
n_zh: 维基百科称他1654年因清军搜捕流亡零陵、郴州一带变姓名为瑶人，未提1653年。

n: The English article says he set off for Chang'an at nineteen (about 718), not fifteen.
n_zh: 英文维基称其十九岁赴长安应试（约718年），而非十五岁。

n: Sources disagree: the English article gives 721 for his jinshi, while the Chinese article gives 719 for the jinshi and 720 for the demotion to Jizhou.
n_zh: 各源不一：英文维基作721年中进士，中文维基作719年进士及第、720年贬济州。

n: Wikipedia zh says he studied with Lady Wei from age 7 (309), and in 318 began studying with his uncle Wang Yi; the marriage was in 323.
n_zh: 维基百科称王羲之309年起随卫夫人学书，318年起随叔父王廙学书，323年被郗鉴选为婿。

n: English Wikipedia dates the General of the Right and Kuaiji appointment to 347; other accounts give 351.
n_zh: 英文维基称其于347年任右军将军、会稽内史，另有351年之说。

n: The English article dates her selection to 36 BC, while the Chinese article gives 38 BC (建昭元年).
n_zh: 英文条目称前36年入选，中文条目则作建昭元年（前38年），来源不一。

n: The passages date Wei's Illustrated Treatise to January 1843 and say he wrote it while staying in Nanjing, not Yangzhou in 1842 (1842 was the Shengwu Ji).
n_zh: 维基称《海国图志》成于1843年1月，写作时魏源长年在南京，而非1842年在扬州（1842年是《圣武记》）。

n: The Chinese article says his father died the year Wu became a xiucai at 18 (c. 1718-1720), not 1723.
n_zh: 中文条目称吴敬梓十八岁考取秀才那年父亲去世（约1718至1720年），而非1723年。

n: Chinese Wikipedia says he went to teach in Shaozhou and met Cattaneo in 1593, not 1595.
n_zh: 中文维基称徐光启万历二十一年（1593年）赴韶州任教并结识郭居静，而非1595年。

fix.text: 1593: Working as a tutor in Shaozhou, he meets the Jesuit Lazzaro Cattaneo, his first contact with Christianity.
fix.text_zh: 1593年，在韶州教书，结识耶稣会士郭居静，首次接触天主教。

n: Wikipedia (en) says Lord Chunshen invited him in 240 BCE, while the zh article says 255 BC.
n_zh: 英文条目称春申君于前240年召他任兰陵令，中文条目则作前255年。

n: Wikipedia says that in 1906 he went to Anqing as head of the Anhui Normal School (安徽师范学堂), not the Higher School.
n_zh: 维基百科称1906年他赴安庆任安徽师范学堂监督，而非高等学堂。

n: Sources place his capture by Hou Jing at 548 (age eighteen), not 551.
n_zh: 文献称其于548年（十八岁）被侯景俘获囚送建康，而非551年。

n: Wikipedia says he joined Xiao Gang's staff at nineteen (c. 531), not c. 527.
n_zh: 维基百科称其十九岁（约531年）入萧纲文德省，而非约527年。

n: The zh article dates his life to c. 300-260 BC, not c. 310 birth; birth year is uncertain.
n_zh: 中文条目作约前300年—约前260年，与约前310年出生不合，生年不确定。

n: The zh article gives his death as c. 260 BC in Zhao, not c. 250.
n_zh: 中文条目称他约卒于前260年，卒于赵，与约前250年不合。

n: Wikipedia says he stayed teaching at the Mawei school from 1884 and was moved to the Whampoa naval school in Guangzhou in 1885; no Bowen Academy is mentioned.
n_zh: 维基百科称他1884年起留马尾后学堂任教，1885年才调广州黄埔水师学堂，未提博学馆。

n: Wikipedia says he became head of the Guangdong commercial Canton-Hankow Railway company in 1910 and was based in Hankou, with the Han-Yue-Chuan post added in 1912.
n_zh: 维基百科称他1910年任广东商办粤汉铁路总公司总理，1912年兼任汉粤川铁路会办，并定居汉口。

n: Birth year differs between sources: Chinese Wikipedia gives 175 BC, the usual estimate is 164 BC.
n_zh: 生年各说不一：中文维基作前175年，常见说法为前164年。

n: Wikipedia gives conflicting dates for the Grand Council appointment (1880 or June 1884 in the English article, 1884 in Chinese), none being 1881.
n_zh: 维基记载左宗棠入军机处为1880年（英文）或1884年6月，1881年他已出任两江总督，均与1881年入京任军机大臣不符。

n: Wikipedia (after Ge et al.) gives China's two marked cold spells as the 1620s–1710s and 1800s–1860s, not the 1450s, 1620s–1690s and 1840s–1870s named here.
n_zh: 维基百科（引葛全胜等）所列中国两个显著冷期为1620—1710年代与1800—1860年代，与此处所说的1450年代、1620—1690年代、1840—1870年代不尽相同。

n: Source dates Bodhidharma's meeting with Emperor Wu to 527 and it is a later legend.
n_zh: 资料称达摩见梁武帝在527年，且为后世记载的传说。

n: Wikipedia's Cao Rui article says his parentage is disputed, though Cao Pi's article calls him Cao Pi's eldest son.
n_zh: 维基曹叡条称其生父存疑，但曹丕条称其为曹丕长子。

n: Wikipedia names Gao Shi and Xue Ju (not Du Fu) as Cen Shen's companions on the pagoda poem; Du Fu is only said to have befriended him around 751.
n_zh: 维基称岑参登慈恩寺塔诗的同游者为高适、薛据，未提杜甫；杜甫仅被说于约751年与其结交。

n: Wikipedia (zh) dates Confucius's visit to Chang Hong to c. 496-495 BC, not 518 BC.
n_zh: 维基百科称孔子访乐于苌弘在约前496至前495年，而非前518年。

n: Wikipedia dates Dai Kui's Resolving Doubts and letter to Huiyuan to 393 or 394, not 390.
n_zh: 维基称戴逵撰《释疑论》并致书慧远在393或394年，而非390年。

n: The date of the Three Responses is disputed: Chinese Wikipedia gives 140 BC, others 134 BC.
n_zh: 《天人三策》年份有争议：中文维基作建元元年（前140年），另有元光元年（前134年）之说。

n: The English article says she respected Gao Jiong, while the Chinese article says she was held to have contributed to his fall.
n_zh: 英文条目称独孤皇后敬重高颎，中文条目则称她被认为是高颎被废的原因之一，说法不一。

n: Wikipedia dates Wei Zifu's meeting with Emperor Wu and entry to the palace to 139 BC (Jianyuan 2), not 131 BC.
n_zh: 维基称卫子夫被武帝临幸、入宫在建元二年（前139年），而非前131年。

n: Source places the 1638 defeat of Li Zicheng on the Shaanxi-Sichuan border, not near Tongguan.
n_zh: 维基称1638年洪承畴在陕川边境击败李自成，未提潼关。

n: Wikipedia places Ji Kang and Xiang Xiu's forge at Shanyang (modern Jiaozuo), not near Luoyang.
n_zh: 维基称嵇康与向秀锻铁于河内山阳（今焦作），并非洛阳城外。

n: Wikipedia puts the Tong Pass campaign in 211 (Zhong Yao article); 199 is when Zhang Xiu surrendered on Jia Xu's advice.
n_zh: 维基将潼关之战置于211年；199年是张绣依贾诩之议降曹。

n: The Chinese article places Kangxi's southern tour meeting with Mei Wending the year after 1702, i.e. 1703.
n_zh: 中文维基称康熙四十一年荐书，次年南巡召见梅文鼎，即1703年。

n: Wikipedia says Kuai Xiang was ordered to design the Forbidden City in 1407, and most palaces were finished by end 1417, so 1417 is the completion not the start.
n_zh: 维基称蒯祥于1407年奉命设计营建紫禁城，1417年底宫殿大体完工，1417年并非起始年。

n: Sources say Confucius asking Laozi about ritual rests on Shiji tradition; modern scholars dispute Laozi's identity and dates.
n_zh: 孔子问礼于老子出自《史记》传说，学界对老子身份与年代存在争议，朱熹亦有疑。

n: Wikipedia (zh) dates Li Kui's appointment as chancellor to 422 BC, far from 406 BC.
n_zh: 维基百科称李悝被任为相国在前422年，与前406年相差甚远。

n: The Chinese article says the Tang histories credit Li Shimin with the Yanmen rescue, but the Qiju zhu says Li Yuan did it, which most scholars follow.
n_zh: 中文条目称新旧唐书记李世民救驾，但《大唐创业起居注》记为李渊解围，学界多采后说。

n: Source dates Liu Xie's post as Xiao Tong's secretary to c. 510-513, not clearly 518.
n_zh: 资料推断刘勰任萧统通事舍人约在510至513年前后，并非明确的518年。

n: Evidence mentions Liu Yan received by Xuanzong at age ten, not eight.
n_zh: 文献提到玄宗接见的是十岁的刘晏，而非八岁。

n: Wikipedia says Fusu was sent to the northern frontier as army supervisor under Meng Tian in 212 BC.
n_zh: 维基百科称扶苏于前212年被派往北边任蒙恬监军。

n: Sources describe Ou Yezi as Gan Jiang's teacher (or father-in-law), not a fellow student under the same master.
n_zh: 资料称欧冶子是干将的老师（或岳父），而非同师学艺的同门。

n: Sources date Qin's defeat of Zhang Xianzhong at Kuizhou to 1634 and her defeat by him to 1644; 1640 was against Luo Rucai.
n_zh: 维基载秦良玉1634年败张献忠于夔州，1640年所败为罗汝才，1644年反被张击败。

n: Wikipedia says Tang Yin may have learned from Shen Zhou early on but shows little Shen influence and mainly studied under Zhou Chen.
n_zh: 维基称唐寅早年可能向沈周学画，但作品少见沈周风格，主要师从周臣。

n: Sources call this only a tradition; modern scholars date the Shizhoupian to Qin of the Warring States.
n_zh: 来源称此仅为传说，现代学者多认为《史籀篇》为战国秦人所作。

n: Wikipedia says Huizong abdicated to Qinzong in January 1126; 1100 is Qinzong's birth year.
n_zh: 据维基百科，徽宗于1126年禅位于钦宗；1100年是钦宗出生之年。

n: One zh passage says 第八子, others show seventh son/youngest; sources differ.
n_zh: 中文条目一处称献之为第八子，他处称第七子或幼子，说法不一。

n: Wikipedia dates Wei Zifu's meeting with Emperor Wu and entry to the palace to 139 BC (Jianyuan 2), not 131 BC.
n_zh: 维基称卫子夫被武帝临幸、入宫在建元二年（前139年），而非前131年。

n: Chinese article dates Yang Ye's capture to Song's 986 campaign, but the English article places his death in a 989 invasion.
n_zh: 中文条目称杨业于986年北伐中被俘，英文条目则称其死于989年的宋军入侵，来源不一。

n: Sources disagree on the year: English passage says Lord Chunshen invited him to Lanling in 240 BCE, Chinese passage says 255 BC.
n_zh: 来源年份不一：英文条目称前240年春申君任命其为兰陵令，中文条目称前255年。

n: Wikipedia dates the marriage to 557, when he was 16 and she 13.
n_zh: 维基百科记载二人于557年成婚，时杨坚16岁、独孤伽罗13岁。

n: Wikipedia says Xiao Deyao introduced Jiang Kui to Yang Wanli in 1187; it does not say Yang introduced him to Fan Chengda.
n_zh: 维基称1187年经萧德藻介绍姜夔谒见杨万里，并未说杨万里把他引荐给范成大。

n: Wikipedia says the Taizu Emperor summoned him to the capital in the second year of Hongwu (1369); he died in 1370.
n_zh: 维基载洪武二年（1369年）明太祖召其至京师议订礼法，1370年逝世。

n: The Hong Taiji article says he was defeated by Yuan Chonghuan in 1628, while the Yuan article only says the second Battle of Ningyuan, so the year is unclear.
n_zh: 皇太极条目称其1628年被袁崇焕击败，袁崇焕条目仅称第二次宁远之战，年份不明确。

n: The source says Emperor Wu withdrew from Pingyang rather than engage Gao Wei's army, leaving Liang Shiyan in charge.
n_zh: 来源称周武帝闻齐军来援即撤兵，留梁士彦守平阳，并未亲自击败高纬。
